title: Temporary home water shutoff label
summary: A simple label for a water valve after leak, burst pipe, flood return, or municipal repair so nobody reopens it before the hazard is understood.
content: Core sequence: 1) Attach a large label to the valve with closed time, reason, affected rooms, and who may reopen it. 2) Tell all household members where safe drinking water is stored before closing the valve. 3) Keep a small test container ready for first reopening only after the leak or contamination concern is resolved. 4) Remove the label only when the responsible person confirms no active leak, electrical wet area, or official advisory remains.
